title: Back up and retire legacy production thin-turn (blocked until 2026-10-29)
description:
Part of story chatticus-e50451 (group G3). Legacy ChatticusThinTurnProduction: table (97 items, 28 KB), 2 queues, 4 Lambdas with a public Function URL, scheduler group, active invoke-key secret, 7 SSM parameters, plus the retained legacy staging table (62 items) and queues and 3 openai-api-key SSM parameters. Blocked until 2026-10-29 (front door last invoked 2026-10-14). Steps: on-demand backup named like the existing retire backups, owner decision on whether the 97 items (vs 39 in the Chatticus-account table) are needed and, if so, an owner-run script archive into the Chatticus account (no standing cross-account policy), then delete the stack and retained items. Consider rotating the vendor key whose three copies existed. Rollback: restore the backup in the legacy account.

Feature: Legacy thin-turn retired
  Scenario: State preserved then removed
    Given a verified backup of the production table
    When the legacy thin-turn stack and leftovers are deleted
    Then no Chatticus thin-turn resource remains in the legacy account

comments.author: home
comments.text: On-demand backup chatticus-legacy-retire-production-messaging-20261026 taken 2026-10-26 on the legacy production messaging table: status AVAILABLE, 97 items, 28149 bytes. No cross-account copy, no standing cross-account policy. Table deletion is not allowed before 2026-10-29. Restore: aws dynamodb restore-table-from-backup into a new legacy table. Lead parity already confirmed (chatticus-eb508a).
